expected.canonical_headline: Road rage shooting on SW Brevity Terrace leads to arrest of two Port St. Lucie men
selected_headlines: Two men charged after road rage shooting on SW Brevity Terrace in Port St. Lucie
source_headlines: 'Just heard like two big pop pops': Two men arrested after road rage shooting in Port St. Lucie - WPBF
novel_facts: Additional location details: near Southwest California Boulevard and Southwest Brevity Terrace, incident began near Southwest Crosstown Parkway
Witness quotes from neighbors Ripley Crawford and Ernie Lampreda describing gunfire sounds and traffic disruption
Context: Kukielka was traveling with his girlfriend after visiting a restaurant
Investigation details: shell casings, surveillance video, and dash cam footage collected
St. Lucie County Sheriff's deputy observed the incident and detained Kukielka
Both transported to HCA Florida Lawnwood Hospital
Specific statute citations: Florida Statute 782.04(2) and 810.02(2)(a)
Detail that misunderstanding began with lane change/merging, no intentional following occurred
